name: SimeonOnSecurity: Windows Optimize, Harden, Debloat
description: A third-party script that applies the DoD STIG baselines and its author's own hardening to Windows 10 and 11. Phoenix runs it as it is, at one pinned commit, with only the parts you tick. It changes a great deal at once and has no undo of its own beyond the restore point it takes.

options.name: disabletelemetry
options.label: Disable telemetry
options.why: Turns off data collection and telemetry.

options.name: privacy
options.label: Privacy settings
options.why: Its author's privacy changes.

options.name: removebloatware
options.label: Remove bloatware
options.why: Removes preinstalled programs and features. Phoenix packs already remove the ones they list; this removes its own, longer list.

options.name: mitigations
options.label: General mitigations
options.why: Best-practice mitigations for known attack classes.

options.name: defenderhardening
options.label: Defender hardening
options.why: Hardens Windows Defender beyond the STIG.

options.name: pshardening
options.label: PowerShell hardening
options.why: PowerShell hardening and logging.

options.name: sslhardening
options.label: SSL hardening
options.why: Turns off old TLS and SSL versions and weak ciphers. Very old servers and devices may stop connecting.

options.name: smbhardening
options.label: SMB hardening
options.why: Hardens file-sharing client and server settings. Old NAS boxes and printers may stop connecting.

options.name: nessusPID
options.label: Fix unquoted service paths
options.why: Resolves unquoted system strings in paths (Nessus plugin 63155).

options.name: applockerhardening
options.label: AppLocker (audit only)
options.why: Installs and configures AppLocker in audit-only mode.

options.name: bitlockerhardening
options.label: BitLocker policy
options.why: Hardens the BitLocker policy. It changes what BitLocker demands at start-up; know your recovery key first.

options.name: deviceguard
options.label: Device Guard
options.why: Turns on Device Guard (virtualization-based security). Can slow virtual machines and games.

options.name: sysmon
options.label: Sysmon
options.why: Installs and configures Sysmon for auditing.

options.name: windows
options.label: Windows 10/11
options.why: The Windows desktop STIGs. The strictest part: it can lock out sign-in options, remote desktop and features you use.

options.name: defender
options.label: Windows Defender
options.why: The Windows Defender STIG.

options.name: firewall
options.label: Windows Firewall
options.why: The Windows Firewall STIG.

options.name: edge
options.label: Microsoft Edge
options.why: The Chromium Edge STIG.

options.name: chrome
options.label: Google Chrome
options.why: The Chrome STIG. It can block extensions and sign-in sync.

options.name: firefox
options.label: Firefox
options.why: The Firefox STIG.

options.name: dotnet
options.label: .NET Framework
options.why: The .NET 4 STIG.

options.name: office
options.label: Microsoft Office
options.why: The Office STIGs.

options.name: onedrive
options.label: OneDrive
options.why: The OneDrive STIGs.

options.name: adobe
options.label: Adobe Acrobat Reader
options.why: The Acrobat Reader STIGs.

options.name: java
options.label: Oracle JRE 8
options.why: The Java JRE 8 STIG.

options.name: IE11
options.label: Internet Explorer 11
options.why: The IE 11 STIG.

options.name: emet
options.label: EMET (Windows 7)
options.why: EMET requirements for Windows 7 systems.

options.name: sosbrowsers
options.label: Browser settings
options.why: Its author's browser configuration.

options.name: cleargpos
options.label: Clear existing group policy first
options.why: Wipes the local group policy before applying. Anything you set by policy is lost.

options.name: installupdates
options.label: Install Windows updates
options.why: Installs Windows updates. Phoenix normally keeps Windows Update off.

options.name: updatemanagement
options.label: Update settings
options.why: Changes how updates are managed.

options.name: imagecleanup
options.label: Image cleanup
options.why: Cleans unneeded files from the system image.

options.name: diskcompression
options.label: Compress the system disk
options.why: Compresses the whole system drive. Slow to do and slow to undo.
